turns.q: Focus Legacy producer groups and total, all years?
turns.answer:
Across all financial years for Meghalaya, the Focus Legacy scheme recorded 11,906 producer groups, 1,02,021 memberships, and ₹51,01,05,000 (≈ ₹51.01 crore) amount disbursed. Counted as memberships paid for, not as distinct people — a group paid in more than one year is counted each time.

Note: Focus Legacy data covers FY 2021-22, FY 2022-23, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26.

turns.q: How many CM Elevate applications were sent back in West Garo Hills?
turns.answer: 11 CM Elevate applications in West Garo Hills have the file status Send Back (of 1,625 valid applications); those that also meet the rest of the rule are counted among the 1,619 pending. Pending means: data verified Valid, and file status Pending or Send Back.
turns.rewritten: How many CM Elevate (applications) applications were sent back in West Garo Hills
turns.sql: /* cme-sector-workflow */ SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) FILTER (WHERE data_verified = 'Valid' AND file_status IN ('Pending', 'Send Back')) AS pending, COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) FILTER (WHERE file_status = 'Send Back') AS sent_back, COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) FILTER (WHERE file_status = 'Rejected') AS rejected, COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) FILTER (WHERE current_file_status = 'forward') AS forward, COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) FILTER (WHERE current_file_status = 'resubmit') AS resubmit, COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) FILTER (WHERE current_file_status = 'sendback to vdv/citizen') AS sendback, COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) AS applications FROM curated.v_cm_elevate WHERE lgd_district = $1 AND data_verified = 'Valid'
